decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (6411-PL01, 6411-PL02B, 6411-PL03A and 6411-OS) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 33 Ellerdine Road.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in either flank wall of the extension or the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Any new window formed in the side elevation of the outbuilding shall be obscure glazed, non-opening and no less than 1.7 metres above the floor of the room in which the window is installed
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, removal of one side window and its replacement and erection of a detached outbuilding.
